# Raw operation constructor and Meaning study

This informed study under #83/#46 preserves five complete first programs before
Raw changes, seven actual baseline observations and five later observations.
No external model was invoked and no blind authoring result is claimed.

The first tensor oracle used an unsupported classical statement body. Both parse
failures remain in attempt-01. Attempt-02 changes only those two complete
programs to supported parameter patterns and expression bodies; its two initial
Raw refusals are distinct from the original parse failures.

After implementation, unchanged sequence X;X, adjoint T and ordered left-X tensor
programs pass their independently declared exact finite Meaning requests. The
wrong-axis tensor and false child refinement below zero repetition reject at the
native contract check. Original refusals and raw output bytes remain unchanged.
The session lists every actual check; the authoring checker does not replay them.

Separate Rust tests compare complex results with independently written identity,
inverse-eighth-phase and ordered-axis expectations. Raw source replay tests also
reject native-valid gate/phase substitutions for all five constructors, and an
axis permutation in a differing-tree adjoint whose original caller retains a
separate owner. These are bounded checks, not an AST-to-step preservation proof,
a new constitutional guarantee or completion of the broader #83/#46 conditions.
Unsupported Raw primitives and rectangular Meaning equations remain open.

## Raw interval connection

Ten additional observations reuse the unchanged first sources with explicit
`--ir-profile=raw`. Before this connection all five reject at the unchecked
Meaning boundary. Afterwards sequence and ordered tensor check successfully;
wrong tensor axes and the false zero-repeat child reach native contract
rejection. The adjoint's original equation checks, but its actual transformed
Raw interval remains explicitly unsupported. These observations do not replace
the earlier hierarchy checks or claim complete #83/#46 support.

The before observations use the previously built MSRV executable; its actual
binary hash is recorded, without claiming a newly rebuilt baseline. The after
observations use the current latest executable. Each retains its actual command,
source hash, binary hashes, output and exit code. No original source or earlier
observation was edited. New regression tests separately reject a genuine native
leaf for the wrong action when bound to the actual emitted X interval; preserve
a suspended owner and scalar work; and keep zero-budget rejection. The native
checker, protocol and constitutional guarantees are unchanged. Rectangular
Meanings, transformed Raw requests and general source/runtime preservation
remain required work, not waived acceptance conditions.

## Subsequent transformed interval work

The later [transformed Raw Meaning study](../refined-raw-access-v030/README.md)
adds inverse/control substep checks and conditional coordinate reconstruction.
The unchanged adjoint source now also passes the library's refined Raw regression.
The earlier unsupported observations above remain historical evidence; source
`ctrl` and rectangular Meanings still require separate work.
